name: Row Between Chairs
instructions: Place two chairs a bit apart and lay a sturdy bar or broomstick across them.
Lie underneath and grip the bar.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest to the bar.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A bodyweight inverted row using two chairs and a broom or sturdy bar.
